Score:

(automate the manual steps of getting results data). Need an easy way to start / stop this in case things have to be fixed.

Web:
Use winscp auto sync to keep the online aero-judge results folder updated with the latest results.

We need to look at the figures folder structure and see if we can align it with this to have the device select the right image data from the image/audio generation tools I just setup:

These are how the files are created, and could be pushed to the device - so we need to update for the device to know what to look for (short_desck in sequences.dat defines the folder name) and where...

My thought are to simply what is in the figure/en/ folder to three sub folders, default audio, default folders, event folders.
The only reason to separate default folders and event folders is that its easier to clear everything at once in event folders without the risk of losing default data files.  

/figures/en/
      	audio/		// contains all default audio (score numbers, now judging etc.)
      	default/		// contains default image and audio files
		BAK_26S
		SPK_26S
		INK_26S
		INK_26A
		... 		// follows defined folder structure order
	event/
		SPU_8TD		// example Sportsman unknown folder
		UNU_YY6		// example Unlimited unknow folder
		...  // file names generated during creation

Event files could stay in place until system software updates ? or some other clean up command. File sizes are pretty small so wont ever be an issue. 

Folder name format is CCK_### (saved in sequences.dat score_short_desc for lookup)

CC = Class, BA -BAsic, SP -SPortsman, IN - Intermediate, IV -Invitational etc..
K = Known / Unknown
_ = Separator
### is an identifier. 	26S = 2026 Standard Seq, 26A = 2026 Alt Seq, or *** = Unique identifier generated for that sequence.

Examples:
BAK_26S = Basic Known 2026 Std Sequence
ULK_26A = Unlimited Known 2026 ALT Sequence
ADU_TD4 = Advanced Unknown - Event specific

comments.body:
# Proposed Figures/en Folder Structure

Flat structure using folder naming convention instead of deep nesting. This is to support the folder naming structure generated from the AeroJudge sequence conversion processes. 

## Folder Structure

```
figures/en/
├── default/                      # Annual default sequence folders
│   ├── ADK_26S/                  # Advanced Known 2026 Standard
│   ├── ADK_26A/                  # Advanced Known 2026 Alternate
│   ├── ADU_26S/                  # Advanced Unknown 2026 Standard
│   ├── BAS_26S/                  # Basic Known 2026 Standard
│   ├── ...
│   └── FRSTYLE/                  # Freestyle 2026 Standard
├── audio/                        # Shared audio (scores, announcements)
└── event/                        # Custom event uploads (clearable)
    ├── ADK_X7F/                  # Advanced Known, custom round
    └── INU_RR5/                  # Intermediate Unknown, custom round
```

## Folder Naming Convention

### Known/ Unknown Default Sequences

```
{CLASS}{TYPE}_{YEAR}{VARIANT}
```

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Class** | `BA` = Basic, `SP` = Sportsman, `IN` = Intermediate, `AD` = Advanced, `UN` = Inlimitided, `IV` = Invitational |
| **Type** | `K` = Known, `U` = Unknown |
| **Year** | `26` = 2026, `25` = 2025, etc. |
| **Variant** | `S` = Standard, `A` = Alternate |

### Freestyle Sequence ###

```
FRSTYLE
```

### Custom Sequences

```
{CLASS}{TYPE}_{RANDOM}
```

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| **Class.Type** | Same as above |
| **Random** | 3-character key for specific round/flight |

### Examples

| Folder | Type | Meaning |
|--------|------|---------|
| `ADK_26A` | Default | Advanced Known 2026 Standard |
| `BAS_26S` | Default | Basic Known 2026 Alternate |
| `ADK_X7F` | Custom | Advanced Known, round-specific |
| `SPU_RM3` | Custom | Sportsman Unknown, round-specific |

## Folder Contents

### Sequence Folders (e.g., `default/ADK_26S/`)

Internal filenames unchanged:

```
ADK_26S/
├── 1B.svg, 1C.svg ... 12B.svg, 12C.svg
├── fig1.mp3 ... fig12.mp3
└── call1.mp3 ... call10.mp3
```

### `audio/`

```
audio/
├── 0.mp3 ... 10.mp3              # Whole scores
├── 0_5.mp3 ... 9_5.mp3           # Half-point scores
├── break.mp3
├── not_observed.mp3
└── now_judging_*.mp3, ...
```

### `event/`

Custom uploads with 3-character random key:

```
event/
├── ADK_X7F/
│   ├── 1B.svg
│   ├── fig1.mp3
│   └── ...
└── SPU_RM3/
    └── ...
```

## Comparison

| Aspect | Current | Proposed |
|--------|---------|----------|
| Depth | 4-5 levels (`alt/known/advanced/`) | 2 levels (`sequences/ADK_26S/`) |
| Folders | 27 directories | 3 root + sequence folders |
| Custom events | Not supported | `custom/` folder (clearable) |

## Lookup Priority

1. Get `{short_desc}` from sequences.dat (round and type specific input)
2. Lookup `event/{short-desc}/` (For custom content. Use if matched)
3. If no match use appropriate default `sequences/{class}_{year}{variant}/`


## Migration

- `std/known/advanced/` → `sequences/ADK_26S/`
- `alt/known/advanced/` → `sequences/ADK_26A/`
- `score/` → `audio/`
- `now_judging_*.mp3` → `audio/`

Completed, Nov 2025 - Included in proposed version 2.0
This was what started my rabbit hole venture!

Here is the situtation that I just remotely fixed for someone running a contest.

Contest is setup for two rounds of knowns, 1 round of unknowns.

late in the first day - they decide to only fly one known round - So round 3 sequence 1 was flown but they exited out of sequence 2.

The next morning the flew unknowns which was saved in the device as Round 3 sequence 2.

comments.body:
I've about got the aero-judge website side of things setup to handle this and be able to display concurrent live events automatically, with all the other archival tasks automated to keep it flowing....

I'm asking about Score capabilities as I haven't got access to score to be able to look ( @DanCInOz @sputnik-dancarroll - it would be nice to have access to that repo)

How It Works

  1. Score! exports a zip file containing:
    - report_results3.xml (required - contains event data)
    - report_results.html (main results page)
    - report_pilot_{*}.html (individual pilot detail pages)
  2. Score! POSTs the zip to our API endpoint
  3. Our server automatically:
    - Extracts the HTML files
    - Parses metadata from XML (event name, date, region, classes, participant count)
    - Stores metadata in database
    - Deploys HTML files to results/live/{event_id}/
    - Results are immediately viewable at https://aero-judge.com/results/live/{event_id}/report_results.html

  API Endpoint (Phase 1 - Coming Soon)

  POST https://aero-judge.com/api/results/upload        
  Headers:
    X-API-Key: {provided_api_key}
    Content-Type: multipart/form-data
  Body:
    file: {zip file}

  What Score! Needs to Add

  1. Add event ID into XML - Add <event_id> tag to report_results3.xml:
 ''' <report>
      <type>results</type>
      <event_id>2503</event_id>  **<!-- NEW: Unique event identifier - This exists but is not in the xml file -->**
      <contest_name>2025 SE Season Opener</contest_name>
      <timestamp>8-Mar-2025 20:16</timestamp>
      <region>SE</region>
      ...
  </report>'''
  2. HTTP POST capability - Ability to upload the zip to our endpoint with API key authentication       


  **Questions for Score! Dev**

  1. Can Score! make HTTP POST requests with file       
  uploads?

  2. What can we use event id and add it to report_results3.xml 

  3. Can we add a checkbox on the reports page that sends the zip if checked (and online).

body: Currently if you hold a button, it advances multiple times in quick succession. It should force the person to release the button and press again to advance an additional value.

comments.body:
You can disable the keyboard repeat delay in Raspbian by adjusting the keyboard settings using xset. Follow these steps:

Method 1: Using xset

1. Open a terminal.


2. Run the following command to disable key repeat entirely:

xset r off


3. If you only want to adjust the repeat rate, you can try:

xset r rate 660 25

The first number (660) is the delay in milliseconds before repeating starts.

The second number (25) is the repeat rate (keys per second).



4. To make the change permanent, add the command to your ~/.xsessionrc or ~/.bashrc:

echo "xset r off" >> ~/.xsession

Was able to do this by adding the two commands to ~/.bashrc:
export DISPLAY=:0
xset r off

This can be added to the judge_update.sh script for implementation during next upgrades.
